facts.fact: The ruling applies Regulation 30 on cross-border transfers and Regulation 48 on offences, a fine up to three currency points a day or six months' imprisonment.

In a ruling dated 18 July 2025 on a complaint of 8 November 2024, the PDPO found Google in breach for operating unregistered and transferring data abroad without adequate safeguards, and gave it 30 days to register and submit transfer-compliance evidence; compensation was declined as outside its authority.
